ORDER BY open_issues DESC

input.sql: SELECT ref, name, owner FROM services;

calls.name: query

input.sql:
WITH open_counts AS (
  SELECT service, COUNT(*) AS open_count
  FROM issues
  WHERE LOWER(state) = 'open'
  GROUP BY service
), max_count AS (
  SELECT MAX(open_count) AS max_open FROM open_counts
)
SELECT oc.service, oc.open_count, s.ref AS service_ref, s.owner
FROM open_counts oc
JOIN max_count mc ON oc.open_count = mc.max_open
LEFT JOIN services s ON s.name = oc.service
ORDER BY oc.service;

questions.question: Which service owns the file with the most total churn (additions plus deletions summed over every pull request that touched it)? Answer with the service ref.

calls.name: describe
query

input.sql: SELECT number, files FROM pull_requests LIMIT 20;

calls.name: query

input.sql: SELECT number, additions+deletions AS churn, value AS path FROM pull_requests, json_each(files) LIMIT 50;

calls.name: query

input.sql:
SELECT replace(value, '"', '') AS path, SUM(additions+deletions) AS total_churn
FROM pull_requests, json_each(files)
GROUP BY path
ORDER BY total_churn DESC
LIMIT 10;

input.sql:

calls.name: query

input.sql:
SELECT path, total_churn, (CASE
  WHEN path LIKE 'src/auth/%' THEN 'svc:auth'
  WHEN path LIKE 'src/catalog/%' THEN 'svc:catalog'
  WHEN path LIKE 'src/delivery/%' THEN 'svc:delivery'
  WHEN path LIKE 'src/notify/%' THEN 'svc:notify'
  WHEN path LIKE 'src/search/%' THEN 'svc:search'
  WHEN path LIKE 'src/telemetry/%' THEN 'svc:telemetry'
  WHEN path LIKE 'src/ingest/%' THEN 'svc:ingest'
  WHEN path LIKE 'src/billing/%' THEN 'svc:billing'
  ELSE 'svc:unknown' END) AS service_ref
FROM (
  SELECT replace(json_each.value, '"', '') AS path, SUM(additions+deletions) AS total_churn
  FROM pull_requests, json_each(pull_requests.files)
  GROUP BY json_each.value
  ORDER BY total_churn DESC
  LIMIT 1
) AS t;

questions.question: Which team owns the service whose files have the most total churn (additions plus deletions summed over every pull request that touched a file in that service)? Answer with the team name.

query

calls.name: query

input.sql:
SELECT s.owner, SUM(t.churn) AS total_churn FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT pr.number AS pr_num, f.service, (pr.additions + pr.deletions) AS churn
  FROM pull_requests pr
  JOIN files f ON pr.files LIKE '%' || f.path || '%'
) t
JOIN services s ON t.service = s.name
GROUP BY s.owner
ORDER BY total_churn DESC
LIMIT 10;

input.sql:

FROM pull_requests pr
JOIN files f ON pr.files LIKE '%' || f.path || '%'
LEFT JOIN services s ON f.service = s.name
GROUP BY f.service, s.owner
ORDER BY total_churn DESC
LIMIT 20;
